nom: ANUA Azelaic Acid 3 Cica Skin Clarifying Toner

avis.texte: I actually really like this product. It doesnt leave my skin sticky nor does it iritate my skin. If anytning it has helped with redbess and my acne. I love putting in in my face after i wash it then i use a hydrating toner right after and it leaves my skin with a glass like finish (not in a oily way) ive finished my first bottle of it and will be re purchasing

avis.titre: Good prepping toner but dries sticky before moisturizing
avis.texte: I'm 60+ with sensitive combination skin that's extremely dry around my nose and cheeks. The toner plus serum dry a little sticky, but after applying moisturizer, my skin felt soft and smooth immediately with first time use and ongoing. Need more time to see if the patchy redness goes away but definitely a great start for me after a couple of weeks!
Love this toner compared to others I've tried. It definitely helps with my pores and I have noticed results after 2 weeks of consistent uses

This toner has helped redness from sun damage and past acne marks on my face and chest. I like the liquid formula b/c it's easy to layer other serums over it. Azaleic acid works for me and I'm glad to have found it in a toner form!

I use the serum from this line religiously, figured I'd try another product. This toner immediately made my skin burn and turn red. First time this has ever happened with an Anua product. will be returning.

Got this toner to help with acne and blemishes. Since I've used it for the last couple weeks I've noticed a difference. It's the only change in my skin care routine. However, make sure to use serum and moisturizer after because while it feels refreshing and clean, it can be drying.
I love this toner, I'm using the entire full line of azelaic acid and each product has helped me calm my redness and especially to dry small acne outbreaks

I struggle with sensitive skin, redness, acne, and plugged sebaceous filaments. I bought this hoping it would reduce redness (azaelic acid) and help with the sebaceous filaments and acne (salycilic acid). I've been using this every morning for over a month, and really haven't noticed much improvement in these areas. It is refreshing and I haven't had any negative effects from using it. I'll probably use it until it's gone but won't repurchase.

I can't say that it's anything special but I do suffer from pretty severe rosacea and it hasn't caused me to flare up. I think it definitely minimizes some redness due to acne so that's nice. Also i've only been using for about a week and a half now morning and night.
